game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall, a hall of dripping stalactites: the torchbearer must hold off rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Sentinel Loop: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word.
theme: Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall: a hall of dripping stalactites
core_gameplay_loop: In Stalactite Hall, repeat each round: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word. Then check queue_length and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from rock golems in Stalactite Hall: keep queue_length above zero until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Sentinel Loop
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 4, Level 5, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
